server_path.markdownDescription:
The path to the server binary to use for starting the language server. Use `auto` for the package to manage (install/update) server automatically.

> [!NOTE]
> Change this instead of directly updating `command` - the `${server_path}` variable is dynamically resolved based on this setting.

> [!WARNING]
> Using custom binary could result in package settings not matching what server supports.

workspaceTrusted.markdownDescription: Report the workspace as trusted. With `carve.includes.enabled` at `auto` (the default), the server resolves `{{ path }}` includes only when this is `true`. Sublime Text has no workspace trust of its own, so this is off unless you turn it on.

carve.extensions.markdownDescription: Enabled extension names. `semantic-span` colors `samp`, `var`, `cite` and `dfn` as keywords in span attributes.

carve.inlayHints.markdownDescription: Show inlay hints: generated heading ids, colon-fence closers and the bare list marker hint. `false` turns all of them off; `{ "bareListMarkers": false }` turns off only that one. LSP shows inlay hints only when its `show_inlay_hints` setting is on.

carve.exportActions.markdownDescription: Offer the *Export as Markdown* and *Export as HTML* source actions.

carve.formatter.markdownDescription: `conservative` formats whitespace only; `migration` opts into canonical whole-document conversion.

carve.format.alignTables.markdownDescription: Align table cells in document, range and on-type formatting. The *Align table* code action works without this setting.

carve.severities.markdownDescription: Override the severity of a diagnostic code, for example `{ "table-width-total": "error" }`.

carve.includes.enabled.markdownDescription: Resolve `{{ path }}` includes. `auto` resolves them only when `initializationOptions.workspaceTrusted` is `true`; `on` always; `off` never.

carve.includes.includeRoot.markdownDescription: Containment root for includes. Defaults to the workspace root. Setting it also makes the HTML preview expand includes. Variables such as `${folder}` are expanded.

carve.includes.allowAbsolute.markdownDescription: Allow absolute include paths. They still have to resolve inside the include root.

carve.includes.allowedRemoteHosts.markdownDescription: Hosts a remote include may name. The server has no fetcher, so remote targets are refused either way.

carve.includes.maxBytes.markdownDescription: Total byte budget across the include graph. Defaults to the larger of 1 MiB and 8 times the document.

carve.includes.maxResolverCalls.markdownDescription: Resolver calls one include walk may make.
